summary: Petition under Section 17 (3) and (4) of the Electricity Act, 2003, seeking approval for the creation of security interest by way of mortgage, hypothecation, and other encumbrances over the movable and immovable assets, present and future, of the Petitioner, Rajasthan IV 4B Power Transmission Limited. 2. The Petitioner has filed the Petition seeking approval for the creation of Security Interest by way of the hypothecation/ mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment, etc., over all assets, including movable and immovable assets, project accounts and documents (including assignment of transmission licence), etc. of the Petitioner in favour of the Security Trustee (or its replacement or successor) i.e., IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited (hereinafter referred to as “Respondent No. 2”) to secure the financial assistance availed/ to be availed from the lender and for their subsequent transferees, assigns, novatees including any refinancing lenders, and substitutes thereof and any future or any other Secured Party to the Project by executing the deed of hypothecation and power of attorney in relation thereto, indenture of mortgage, mortgage by deposit of title deeds and such other security documents as per law. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _(d) Pass any other or further order(s) or direction(s) as this Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case and to meet the ends of justice_ ." _“(a) Allow the amendments to the Petition and take on record Amended Petition filed on 11.10.2025 bearing Ref No. 4364/2025 and Amended Memo of Parties filed on 04.09.2025 bearing Ref No. 3859/2025;_ _(d) Pass any other or further order(s) or direction(s) as this Commission may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the present case and to meet the ends of justice_ ." 5. The Petitioner, RIV4BPTL, is registered and incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013. Respondent No. 2, is acting as the Security Trustee for the purpose of holding the securities on behalf of and for the benefit of the lenders i.e., National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (Respondent No. 3), India Infrastructure 7. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Facility Agreement, the secured obligations are secured by as under: 8. The Petitioner has submitted that in terms of the Financing Documents, the Petitioner is required to create security, which is the transaction security (as defined under the Facility Agreement), in favour of a Security Trustee for the benefit of the lenders. 9. The Petitioner has stated that Article 15.2.2 of the Transmission Service Agreement entered into between the Petitioner and the beneficiaries of the project provides that the Petitioner is free to create encumbrance over all or part of the receivables, Letter of Credit or other assets of the project in favour of the lenders or 10. The Petitioner has stated that in view of the provisions of sub-sections (3) and (4) of Section 17 of the Act, the Petitioner, as a licensee, cannot create a Security Interest over all the movable and immovable assets of the Petitioner in favour of a Security Trustee acting on behalf of lenders pursuant to a Facility Agreement dated 26.6.2025 and a Security Trustee Agreement dated 26.6.2025 without approval of the Commission. Accordingly, the Petitioner has filed the present Petition seeking prior approval of the Commission for the creation of a Security Interest over all assets, including the movable and immovable assets for the Project in favour of the Security Trustee pursuant to a Security Trustee Agreement and a Facility Agreement. 11. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 26.8.2025 after notice to the Respondents. Vide RoP dated 26.8.2025 and 30.10.2025, the Respondents, including the newly impleaded, were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. However, no reply has been filed by the Respondents despite the issuance of notice. Accordingly, the matter was reserved for order. 17. The Petitioner has submitted that, in terms of the Financing documents, the Petitioner is required to create a Security Interest for the lender. The Petitioner has submitted that under the Financing Agreements and on enforcement of a security interest, it shall be lawful for the lender and its assigns, transferees, and novates to enter into and take possession of the assets/ properties mortgaged/ hypothecated/ charges assigned for their benefits and substitute themselves or any one of them or its nominees for the Petitioner under any or all of the project document(s). Article _“17. (3) No licensee shall any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part hereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ 23. Petition No. 727/MP/2025, along with 115/IA/2025, is disposed of in terms of the above.
title: Petition under Section 17 (3) and (4) of the Electricity Act, 2003, seeking approval for the creation of security interest by way of mortgage, hypothecation, and other encumbrances over the movable and immovable assets, present and future, of the Petitioner, Rajasthan IV 4B Power Transmission Limited.
